entities.name: PMID:25446422
observations: Prospective/retrospective clinical series of 18 patients with bilateral cytologically benign thyroid nodules treated by RFA in separate sessions for each lobe.
At mean follow-up 18.1 months, mean nodule volume reduction was 75.9% and symptom/cosmetic scores improved.
Serum hormone levels did not differ significantly before treatment versus last follow-up (P>0.05), supporting preservation of thyroid function in this cohort.

entities.name: PMID:37667677
observations: First reported case series of bilateral thyroid-nodule RFA performed in a single setting; six patients were treated in the single-setting cohort and six in a separate-setting comparison cohort.
At 6 months, mean volume reduction was approximately 64% in the single-setting cohort; no complications were reported.
The abstract did not report thyroid-function laboratory outcomes, so it provides limited direct evidence for preservation of thyroid function.

entities.name: Radiofrequency ablation
observations: For bilateral benign thyroid nodules, available direct evidence supports preserved serum thyroid hormone levels after staged bilateral RFA in a small 18-patient cohort.
Evidence for thyroid-function preservation after same-session bilateral RFA is currently limited because the available small case series did not report thyroid-function endpoints.
